diagnosis: The resolveTicketAttachment middleware retrieves the attachment file strictly using attachId without verifying that the file belongs to ticketId or that req.user is the creator or assigned support engineer for the ticket. An attacker can download sensitive screenshots and logs uploaded in private support tickets.
exploit_request:
GET /api/tickets/tkt_1029/attachments/att_priv_998120 HTTP/1.1
Host: support.deskflow.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
